document_host.note: Idox PublicAccess_Live DMS. There is no documents tab on the Idox side: applicationDetails.do?activeTab=documents returns a 200 page reading 'Permission Denied' (not a 403), even after visiting the summary tab on the same session, which reads as bot-blocking but is not. The summary page's tab list shows 'externalDocuments' instead, carrying the single off-host link to this store. The DMS needs no cookie from the Idox session.

endpoints.note: Reach the DMS from the Idox side with applicationDetails.do?activeTab=externalDocuments&keyVal=<keyVal>, which carries the single off-host link. FOLDER1_REF is the human reference with slashes, not the keyVal. The RunThirdPartySearch page embeds the document list as inline JSON rows ({"Guid":…,"Doc_Type":…,"Date_Received":…,"Doc_Ref2":…}); each Guid is then a ViewDocument download. Structurally the same install as Mid Sussex (FileSystemId DM) and Adur & Worthing (DA), so tooling ports with two constant changes: the Idox base URL, and the DMS host plus FileSystemId.

quirks.summary: No documents tab — documents live on a separate PublicAccess_Live DMS, and the standard Recipe C documents tab answers HTTP 200 with 'Permission Denied'.
quirks.detail: A run that follows Recipe C as written gets a 200, finds no file links and reports no error, so the application looks like it has no documents. The 'Permission Denied' text reads as bot-blocking but is not: it persists on a warm session that has just loaded the summary tab.
quirks.workaround: GET applicationDetails.do?activeTab=externalDocuments&keyVal=<keyVal>, follow the single off-host link to the DMS, and use the endpoints recorded above.

quirks.summary: DMS downloads carry no Content-Disposition header — derive the file extension from the content-type.
quirks.detail: Not everything is a PDF: biodiversity net gain workbooks arrive as application/vnd.ms-excel.sheet.macroenabled.12 and belong in a .xlsm.

quirks.summary: Returns HTTP 429 at 2.0s spacing, and the throttling then CASCADES — once tripped, later searches 429 on their very first request, so a single burst can silently truncate a whole enumeration run.
quirks.workaround: >=5s spacing with Retry-After-aware exponential backoff; re-check the run's own row counts after any 429.

quirks.summary: Documents tab returned no file links for a real application.
quirks.detail: Either this application genuinely has no published documents, or the documents live somewhere the standard link pattern does not match. One application was sampled, so this is a signal, not a verdict.
quirks.workaround: Sample a second application before concluding; check for an externalDocuments tab.

pacing.note: 429 observed at 2.0s spacing. Broad description sweeps are expensive here: the keyword "dwelling" over a 2-year window returned 684 results, about 68 paginated requests.

development_type_classification.evidence: Over a full 2-year window, developmentType codes 001/007/006/012 return 25/47/13/46 results.
development_type_classification.caution: A 3-month probe window returned a genuine zero for developmentType 001 and led to a wrong conclusion that Horsham does not populate the classification. Do not judge whether a portal uses developmentType from a short window.

source_notes:
Note the non-standard path: /public-access/, not /online-applications/. DMS host iawpa.horsham.gov.uk, FileSystemId=DH. EXTERNAL-DMS VARIANT of Recipe C — the one that breaks the standard recipe. There is NO documents tab: applicationDetails.do?activeTab=documents returns a 200 page reading 'Permission Denied' (not a 403), even after visiting the summary tab on the same session, which reads as bot-blocking but is not. The summary page's tab list shows 'externalDocuments' instead. GET applicationDetails.do?activeTab=externalDocuments&keyVal=<keyVal> and take the single off-host link to a PublicAccess_Live DMS: <dms-host>/PublicAccess_Live/SearchResult/RunThirdPartySearch?FileSystemId=<id>&FOLDER1_REF=<application reference>. That page embeds the document list as inline JSON rows ({"Guid":…,"Doc_Type":…,"Date_Received":…,"Doc_Ref2":…}); each file is then <dms-host>/PublicAccess_LIVE/Document/ViewDocument?id=<Guid>. No Content-Disposition header — take the extension from the content-type (BNG workbooks arrive as application/vnd.ms-excel.sheet.macroenabled.12 -> .xlsm). The DMS needs no cookie from the Idox session; FOLDER1_REF is the human reference with slashes, not the keyVal. Verified end-to-end 22 Aug 2026: search -> summary -> externalDocuments -> DMS (48 rows on DC/25/1077) -> ViewDocument returned a real PDF (magic bytes %PDF-). RATE LIMIT: returns HTTP 429 at 2.0s spacing and the throttling then CASCADES - once tripped, subsequent searches 429 on the very first request, so a single burst can silently truncate a whole enumeration run. Use >=5s spacing with Retry-After-aware exponential backoff. Broad description sweeps are expensive here (keyword "dwelling" over a 2-year window returns 684 results = ~68 paginated requests).

Structurally the same install as Mid Sussex, so that tooling ports with two constant changes (BASE, DMS host + FileSystemId). TESTING TRAP worth generalising: a 3-month probe window returned a genuine zero for developmentType 001 and led to a wrong conclusion that Horsham does not populate the classification. Over the full 2-year window 001/007/006/012 return 25/47/13/46. Do not judge whether a portal uses developmentType from a short window.

verification.note: Verified end to end: search -> summary -> externalDocuments -> DMS (48 rows on DC/25/1077) -> ViewDocument returned a real PDF (%PDF- magic bytes).
Landing-page survey 2026-09-16: HTTP 200; no vendor fingerprint matched
Search worked over 1-31 July 2026; documents tab had no file links.
